"method_note": "Manual extraction; no script was run, every cell was transcribed by hand and re-read against the printed Markdown. Scope decision: rows were given to the three patients of the family and to the healthy mother I.2, a relative tested for the variant and reported negative for it. Table 2 is a literature table of previously reported index cases; those people are in scope, but the checklist requires one row per person per feature and, without being able to run a script, that was not workable here, so no rows were created for the 12 previously reported index cases of Table 2 nor for the relatives named in its 'Family segregation' row (father, brother, mother, sister, three other family members); the 'sisters' of the c.1639G>A column have no number, so no row was created for them either. Inheritance: the father I.1 carries the same variation, so the daughters' variant is recorded as inherited paternal; for I.1 no parental information is given, so inheritance is 'not reported'. Table 1 uses the word 'No' in a cell; it is read as an explicit negative. 'Genital ulcers were very rare' is read as present, not excluded. A feature reported as normal or negative is recorded as the abnormality it rules out.
